title: Retirement homes formed bowling leagues for this
caption: Wii Sports bowling became a real league sport in US retirement homes. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #wiisports #wii

instagram.caption:
When Wii Sports arrived in 2006, retirement homes discovered something: people who could no longer bowl could still bowl here.

Senior centers formed leagues and national tournaments, with hundreds of teams competing from California to New York.

Some are still going. A team in Tulsa called the UV Okies has gone multiple seasons undefeated.

Who in your family was the Wii Bowling champion?
